Illegal parking, street parking, at mga colorum ang tinarget ng Swift Traffic Action Group (STAG) sa operasyon nito sa dalawang Mabuhay Lane Route ngayong araw.

Partikular na sinuyod ng grupo ang Route 11 at 12 o ang kahabaan ng EDSA, Aurora Blvd. (Tramo), Andrews Ave., PITX, Roxas Blvd., Pasay Taft, at Macapagal.

Nasa 33 ang nahuli sa non-contact apprehension habang 49 naman ang sa physical apprehension. Tatlo naman ang impounded.

Huwag mag-park sa kalsada at mga ipinagbabawal na lugar para iwas-huli, iwas-abala.

#mmda #STAG

🌋  MAYON ERUPTS: A MASTERPIECE OF NATURE OR A LOOMING CATASTROPHE?

The "Perfect Cone" has shattered its silence. Earlier today, Mount Mayon unleashed a violent display of power, sending a massive plume of dark ash into the stratosphere and veining its iconic slopes with rivers of molten fire. While the world watches the breathtaking "near-perfect" symmetry of this eruption, thousands of families in Luzon are facing a terrifying reality.
The Permanent Danger Zone: With Mayon being one of the Philippines' most active volcanoes, many are questioning if the government should enforce stricter, permanent "no-go" zones. Is it fair to allow residential expansion in areas where a "perfect cone" is essentially a ticking time bomb?
